description: Header file defining constants, enums, structs, and a class for date calculation within the CalculatorApp's ViewModel. It includes date difference representation and a sealed class for date operations.

classes.name: DateDifference
classes.description: Struct representing difference in years, months, weeks, and days between two dates.

classes.name: DateCalculationEngine
classes.description: Sealed class providing methods to add, subtract, and compute differences between dates.

methods.name: DateCalculationEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the date calculation engine with a calendar identifier.

methods.name: AddDuration
methods.description: Adds a duration to a start date, returning the resulting date.

methods.name: SubtractDuration
methods.description: Subtracts a duration from a start date, returning the resulting date.

methods.name: TryGetDateDifference
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two dates in specified units.

methods.name: GetDifferenceInDays
methods.description: Private method to compute the difference in days between two dates.

methods.name: TryGetCalendarDaysInMonth
methods.description: Private method to get the number of days in the month of a given date.

methods.name: TryGetCalendarDaysInYear
methods.description: Private method to get the number of days in the year of a given date.

methods.name: AdjustCalendarDate
methods.description: Private method to adjust a date by a specified difference in a given unit.
